Australia Increases Student Visa Fees, Affecting Indian Students

Australia has announced an increase in its Subclass 500 student visa fee, raising it by AUD 500 to AUD 2,500. This change, effective from July 1, 2026, will result in higher costs for international students, including a significant impact on Indian students. The increase is being viewed in the context of similar policy adjustments in countries like Canada and the UK.
